row.title: Submit a requested IRSR within the period specified by the Minister
row.statement: When the Minister requests in writing an issue-related summary report, the manufacturer shall submit the report within the period specified by the Minister (a period of less than 30 days may be set only where the Minister needs the information to determine whether the drug poses a serious and imminent risk to human health).
